questions.question: Is the tracking ID shopnow047c-20 active and owned by this site's operator?
questions.known: Format matches the Associates ID pattern (SRC-02 2(b)).
questions.missing: Account ownership, active status, and whether the ID is registered to the site (SRC-01 §1).
questions.how: Owner logs into Associates Central and opens the tracking ID list (SUG-01 step 1).
questions.blocks: Any claim that links earn commission.

questions.question: Do the submitted short links carry the Associates tag when a shopper clicks them?
questions.known: Four observed final URLs contain no tag= parameter (F-05).
questions.missing: Behaviour when an Associates session is present, and the Associates report for a test click.
questions.how: Owner clicks each link while signed in to Associates Central, then checks the link's tracking report (SUG-01 step 2).

questions.question: Does P03 (link B00hJ57DV) reach a product?
questions.known: It opens an Amazon checkpoint page on two attempts (SRC-16).
questions.missing: The product, its ASIN and its title.
questions.how: Owner opens the link in a normal browser and reports the product, or replaces the link (SUG-08).

questions.question: Is each ASIN the one the owner intends?
questions.known: ASIN read from the destination page of each link (F-01, F-03).
questions.missing: Owner confirmation of intent per product.
questions.how: Owner compares display name and form with the intended product.

questions.question: What are the commission rates for these categories?
questions.known: Commission is a percentage of Qualifying Revenue (SRC-02 Program Policies Section 3).
questions.how: Owner reads the rate card in Associates Central (SRC-03 not retrievable from this environment).

questions.question: What do current prices, availability and ratings look like?
questions.known: They cannot be shown without an approved data source (F-07).
questions.how: Owner decides whether to apply for approved Associates data access (SUG-07).
questions.blocks: Price-based comparisons and any 'best value' claim.

questions.question: Where will the self-hosted analytics receiver run, and who holds its data?
questions.known: Receiver code exists and is tested in analytics/ (T8). GitHub Pages cannot run it.

questions.question: What were the five defined events in the brief?
questions.known: The prior session's five event names are used (IRR-07).
questions.missing: The brief's own definitions. The register containing them is not in the repository (FLG-011).
questions.how: Owner supplies the register or confirms the names in data/analytics_events.json.

questions.question: Which search queries bring readers in, and which guides get read?
questions.missing: Search Console query data and first-party analytics.
questions.how: Owner verifies the site in Google Search Console and then the next topic is chosen from its query data (SUG-10).
questions.blocks: Choosing the next guide from data (the brief's requirement).

questions.question: What is the campaign budget, eligible traffic, and reported order count per channel?
questions.known: The campaign ledger is defined and empty (data/campaign_ledger.csv).
questions.how: Rows are added only from authorized Associates or analytics reports, with a provenance link.
questions.blocks: Any conversion score or revenue forecast. None is made.

questions.question: Who is the author and what is the brand?
questions.missing: Owner's chosen brand, named author and author bio.

questions.question: Does the owner have any material connection to these products (payment, free items, discounts)?
questions.known: The brief does not say. The FTC guide says to disclose any such relationship (SRC-05).
questions.how: Owner answers (FLG-014). The disclosure page then states the answer.

questions.question: Should guides include hands-on testing?
questions.known: No testing has been done. FTC guidance says experience can only be described if it happened (SRC-05).
questions.missing: Owner decision on a testing programme and budget.

questions.question: Is Google Search Console set up for the site?
questions.known: Sitemap and RSS feed are built (T10).
questions.missing: Google account verification and sitemap submission.
questions.how: Owner verifies the GitHub Pages URL in Search Console and submits sitemap.xml (SUG-10).
